parsed.rationale: The cluster row carries no member records, no field lists, no shared_field_count, no Jaccard similarity score, and no differing_slots — all structural_evidence fields are null. Without any grounded evidence of what fields or methods RequestLineJWTExchangeEvent and RequestLineAuthCompletedEvent actually share, any refactor recommendation (e.g., extracting a common base or protocol) would be speculative. Both types reside in the same file (RequestLineAnalytics.swift in MusicShareKit) and are analytics event types whose structural overlap may be coincidental naming convention rather than a true subset relationship.
